props.name: data
props.description:
Series data — omnivorous. A single line passes a flat `TimePoint[]`; a
multi-layer line passes `TimePoint[][]`. To name/color a layer, pass
`{ label, color?, data }` (or an array of them). Time accepts ms or `Date`.
On a numeric or category X axis (`axis.x.type`) points carry `x` in place
of `time`: `{ x: 16, value }` or `{ x: 'EU', value }`.

props.name: options
props.description: Visual options override — colours per layer, stroke width, area fill, stacking, entrance animation, smoothing.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Stroke width in CSS pixels. Default: 1. `0` hides the line stroke.

props.name: area
props.description: Area-fill configuration. Default: `{ visible: true }`.

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the area gradient under the line is rendered. Default: `true`.

props.name: baseline
props.description:
Y value the fill closes to, instead of the plot floor. The fill runs from
the line to this value's pixel row on both sides of it and fades toward
the row; Y autoscale keeps the value in view. A value outside the plotted
Y range clamps to the plot edge. Pair it with a `threshold` at the same
value for a two-color fill (P&L around zero, deviation from a target).

```
<LineSeries
  data={pnl}
  options={{ area: { visible: true, baseline: 0 }, threshold: { value: 0, above: up, below: down } }}
/>
```

Ignored in stacked mode — a stack always closes to its own zero.
Default: the plot floor.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Whether to show an animated pulsing dot at the last data point.

props.name: pulseMs
props.description:
Period of one halo pulse cycle in milliseconds. Continuous loop, not a
one-shot — short values pulse fast, long values pulse slowly. Default:
`600` (≈ 1.7 Hz, a calm "breathing" rhythm).

```
// Per-series override:
<LineSeries options={{ pulseMs: 1200 }} data={data} />

// Chart-level default:
<ChartContainer animations={{ series: { line: { pulse: 1200 } } }}>
  <LineSeries data={data} />
</ChartContainer>
```

`false` or `0` turns the halo off entirely (drawing and animation loop).
A chart-level `animations.series.line: false` is a hard disable that
wins over this field.

props.name: stacking
props.description: Stacking mode. Default: 'off'.

props.name: entryAnimation
props.description:
Entrance animation style for new points. Style is specific to the line
series; there is no chart-level override for style — only for duration.
Default: `'grow'`.
see: entryMs — cross-linked duration for this animation.

props.name: entryMs
props.description:
Per-point entrance duration in milliseconds. Default: `250`.

```
// Override for one series:
<LineSeries options={{ entryMs: 600 }} data={data} />

// Or set the default for every line series at once:
<ChartContainer animations={{ series: { line: { entry: 600 } } }}>
  <LineSeries data={data} />
</ChartContainer>
```

`false` or `0` disables the entrance (equivalent to
`entryAnimation: 'none'`). A chart-level `animations.series.line: false`
is a hard disable that wins over this field.

props.name: introMs
props.description:
Initial-load reveal duration in milliseconds. On the first data seed
(empty → non-empty) the line draws itself left-to-right — stroke and
area sweep in behind a glowing head that rides the reveal front. The
full sweep lasts ~2× `introMs`. Default: `500`.

```
// Per-series override:
<LineSeries options={{ introMs: 800 }} data={data} />

// Chart-level default:
<ChartContainer animations={{ series: { line: { intro: 800 } } }}>
  <LineSeries data={data} />
</ChartContainer>
```

`false` or `0` disables the intro. Bulk re-seeds of a non-empty series
never replay it. Skipped entirely under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

props.name: introAnimation
props.description:
Initial-load reveal choreography — a `LineIntroFn` called once per
frame while the intro plays. The shipped styles are factories over the
same contract: `unfoldIntro()` (the default — amplitude springs from
the mean into shape), `sweepIntro()` (left-to-right draw-on with a
glowing head), `traceIntro()` (faint ghost, then an ink sweep),
`plotterIntro()` (head advances at constant path speed), `centerOutIntro()`
(clip opens from the pane's center outward). Style is specific to the
line series; there is no chart-level override for style — only for
duration (`introMs`).
see: introMs — cross-linked duration for this animation.

props.name: historyReveal
props.defaultValue:
the
line back-fills itself from the data boundary into the new history
behind a moving clip front
props.description:
History-prepend reveal — plays when older points land at the front of
the series (the `EdgeLoader` load-more-on-scroll path). Default: the
line back-fills itself from the data boundary into the new history
behind a moving clip front (`backfillSweepIntro()`).

A custom `LineIntroFn` receives a localized frame: `range` is the
prepended time span with `range.to` at the data boundary (not the
visible window), `width` is that span's bitmap width, and `progress`
runs over the reveal. Value-transform directives are applied to the
prepended points only.

`'none'` disables the reveal — prepended points appear instantly.
see: historyRevealMs — cross-linked duration for this animation.

props.name: historyRevealMs
props.description:
History-prepend reveal duration in milliseconds — the full sweep lasts
~2×. Default: `400`. `false` or `0` disables the reveal. Skipped
entirely under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

props.name: smoothMs
props.description:
How long the displayed last value takes to catch up to the actual one
on every `updateLastPoint`. Default: `250` ms.

```
// Per-series override:
<LineSeries options={{ smoothMs: 100 }} data={data} />

// Chart-level default:
<ChartContainer animations={{ series: { line: { smooth: 100 } } }}>
  <LineSeries data={data} />
</ChartContainer>
```

`0` or `false` snaps the displayed value to the target on every tick
(no smoothing). A chart-level `animations.series.line: false` is a hard
disable that wins over this field.

props.name: curve
props.description:
Declarative line smoothing. Default: `'straight'` (zero visual change —
the prior polyline). Resolves to a shipped built-in path builder inside the
renderer and drives the stroke, the area fill, and stacked slices from one
path:
- `'straight'` — plain polyline.
- `'smooth'` — Fritsch–Carlson monotone cubic (non-overshooting, so it stays
  inside an area fill that closes to a baseline).
- `'stepped'` — horizontal-then-vertical step at each sample.

props.name: linePainter
props.description:
Custom line path builder — a raw `LinePainter` function. Overrides `curve`,
applied per finite run to both the stroke and the area-fill top edge. Read
fresh each frame; keep it a stable reference so the wrapper diffs it cleanly.
A throw falls back to the straight builder. Stacked mode uses the `curve`
kind for gap-free interior tiling, so a custom `linePainter` there falls back
to `'straight'`.

props.name: threshold
props.type: { value: number; above: string; below?: string; }
props.description:
Threshold coloring. Paints the stroke and the area fill one color below a Y
`value` and another above it, with the switch pinned to that value's pixel
row — a vertical canvas gradient, so it tracks the Y-axis as it autoscales.
Use it to make a series visibly "go critical" past a limit: the line runs
calm below the level and hot above it.

Positional, so it is independent of (and overrides) the per-layer
`data.color` for the stroke and fill. Applies to unstacked lines only.

```
<LineSeries data={data} options={{ threshold: { value: 70, above: '#f0556a' } }} />
```

props.name: value
props.description: Y data value where the color switches.

props.name: above
props.description: Color above the threshold (toward the top of the plot).

props.name: below
props.description: Color below the threshold. Default: the series' resolved color.

props.name: points
props.type: { visible: boolean; radius?: number; color?: string; }
props.description:
Dot markers at each data point. Hidden by default.

Dots ride the same animated geometry as the stroke (entrance unfurl,
live-value smoothing, stacked cumulative), so they glide with the line
instead of snapping. When the visible points sit too dense to read as
discrete markers (average spacing under ~1.5 dot diameters, e.g. zoomed
far out), the dots are skipped for that frame — they'd merge into a fat
line and hide the stroke. Zooming back in brings them back.

```
<LineSeries data={data} options={{ points: { visible: true } }} />
```

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether a dot is drawn at each data point.

props.name: radius
props.description: Dot radius in CSS pixels. Default: `3`.

props.name: color
props.description: Fill color override. Default: the layer's resolved series color.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable series ID — same value across remounts.

props.name: visible
props.description: Show/hide the series without unmounting it — excludes it from the Y-range fit and tooltip/legend. Default `true`. Live.

props.name: scale
props.description: Named Y scale from the container's `scales` — autoscales on its own, sharing the time axis. Default: the default scale. Live.

props.name: data
props.description:
Series data — omnivorous. A single-layer bar chart passes a flat
`TimePoint[]`; a multi-layer one passes `TimePoint[][]`. To name/color a
layer, pass `{ label, color?, data }` (or an array of them). Time accepts
ms or `Date`. On a numeric or category X axis (`axis.x.type`) points carry
`x` in place of `time`: `{ x: 16, value }` or `{ x: 'EU', value }`.

props.name: options
props.description: Visual options override — colours per layer, bar-width ratio, stacking, entrance animation, smoothing.

props.name: barWidthRatio
props.description:
Width of each bar as a fraction of the available bar slot (0–1). `1` = bars touch; `0.6` = roughly 60 % of the slot.
Applies on a time or numeric X axis only — on a category axis a bar fills its band (see `axis.x.padding`). Default: 0.6.

props.name: stacking
props.description:
Stacking mode. Default: 'off'. With `'off'`, layers overlap on a time or
numeric X axis and stand side by side in each band on a category axis.
`'percent'` draws each layer as its share of the column's absolute sum, so
a column spans 100% across zero: +3 and -1 give +75% up and -25% down.

props.name: entryAnimation
props.description:
Entrance animation style for newly appended bars. Style is specific to
the bar series; there is no chart-level override for style — only for
duration. Default: `'fade-grow'`.
see: entryMs — cross-linked duration for this animation.

props.name: entryMs
props.description:
Per-bar entrance duration in milliseconds. Default: `250`.

```
// Override for one series:
<BarSeries options={{ entryMs: 600 }} data={data} />

// Or set the default for every bar series at once:
<ChartContainer animations={{ series: { bar: { entry: 600 } } }}>
  <BarSeries data={data} />
</ChartContainer>
```

`false` or `0` disables the entrance (equivalent to
`entryAnimation: 'none'`). A chart-level `animations.series.bar: false`
is a hard disable that wins over this field.

props.name: introAnimation
props.description:
Initial-load intro animation — a `BarIntroFn`, usually one of the
shipped factories: `growIntro()` (the default), `springIntro()`,
`riseIntro()`, `fadeIntro()`, `wipeIntro()`. Independent of
`entryAnimation` — the intro plays once on the first data seed,
streaming entrances keep their own style.
see: introMs — cross-linked duration for this animation.

props.name: introMs
props.description:
Initial-load reveal duration in milliseconds. On the first data seed
(empty → non-empty) bars reveal in a left-to-right wave: each bar
tweens for `introMs`, starts staggered across another `introMs`, so
the full wave lasts ~2×. The visual style is picked by
`introAnimation`. Default: `500`.

```
// Per-series override:
<BarSeries options={{ introMs: 800 }} data={data} />

// Chart-level default:
<ChartContainer animations={{ series: { bar: { intro: 800 } } }}>
  <BarSeries data={data} />
</ChartContainer>
```

`false` or `0` disables the intro. Bulk re-seeds of a non-empty series
never replay it. Skipped entirely under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

props.name: historyReveal
props.description:
History-prepend reveal — plays when older points land at the front of
the series (the `EdgeLoader` load-more-on-scroll path). A wave sweeps
from the data boundary into the new history; each bar's stagger
position is `0` at the boundary and `1` at the deepest new point, so
intro factories that read `el.progress` (`fadeIntro()` — the default,
`riseIntro()`, `growIntro()`, `springIntro()`) work here unchanged.
Clip directives are interpreted in reveal space: `x = 0` at the
boundary, increasing toward the older end.

The fn receives a localized frame: `range` is the prepended time span
(not the visible window) and `width` is that span's bitmap width.

`'none'` disables the reveal — prepended points appear instantly.
see: historyRevealMs — cross-linked duration for this animation.

props.name: historyRevealMs
props.description:
History-prepend reveal duration in milliseconds — the per-bar wave
duration; the full reveal lasts ~2×. Default: `400`. `false` or `0`
disables the reveal. Skipped entirely under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

props.name: smoothMs
props.description:
How long the displayed bar value takes to catch up to the actual one
on every `updateLastPoint`. Default: `250` ms.

```
// Per-series override:
<BarSeries options={{ smoothMs: 100 }} data={data} />

// Chart-level default:
<ChartContainer animations={{ series: { bar: { smooth: 100 } } }}>
  <BarSeries data={data} />
</ChartContainer>
```

`0` or `false` snaps the displayed value to the target on every tick
(no smoothing). A chart-level `animations.series.bar: false` is a hard
disable that wins over this field.

props.name: anchor
props.description:
Where the bar body sits relative to its time slot.

- `'center'` (default) — body centered on the time tick. Standard chart
  look; the leftmost and rightmost bars rely on the surrounding
  `padding.left` / `padding.right` to keep their outer half on canvas.
- `'right'` — body anchored so its right edge sits on the time tick.
  Lets the rightmost bar fit fully inside the canvas with
  `padding.right = 0` (e.g. Sparkline). Not currently a public option —
  subject to change without notice.

props.name: cornerRadius
props.description:
Free-end corner radius in CSS pixels. Default: `2`. `0` is byte-identical to
the pre-rounding square output. The radius is clamped to half the smaller
bar dimension, so thin bars / sub-radius segments degrade to flat.

The renderer decides which edge is "free" per draw mode — a positive bar
rounds its top, a negative bar its bottom, and in a stack only the topmost
(or bottommost) segment per column rounds, interior segments stay square.
`anchor` is orthogonal: rounding operates on the already-offset rect.

props.name: barPainter
props.description:
Custom bar painter — a raw `BarPainter` function that owns the bar fill.
Leave unset for the built-in rounded fill (driven by `cornerRadius`). Read
fresh each frame; a new function reference is honored on the next render
regardless of wrapper change-detection. Keep it a stable reference (module
scope or `useCallback`) so the wrapper diffs it cleanly. A throw falls back
to the default fill.

props.name: projectedFrom
props.description:
Time (epoch ms) at/after which bars are flagged as projected / forecast
"ghost" bars. The default painter fills those with a translucent derivative
of their color; projected bars also skip the entrance transform so the ghost
never double-fades. Omitted: no projected bars.

props.name: valueLabels
props.description:
Value text just past each bar's free end: above a positive bar, below a
negative one. A `'normal'` stack gets one label per signed stack, with its
total; `'percent'` stacks and layers overlapping on a time or numeric axis
get none. A label wider than its bar is skipped. `true` uses the default
format. Color: `theme.bar.labelColor`. Default: off.

props.name: format
props.description: Label text. Default: the Y axis format (`<YAxis format>`), else the axis tick format.

props.name: scale

props.name: body

props.name: wick

props.name: down

props.name: body

PieSeries.description: Pie chart series. Set `options.innerRadiusRatio` > 0 for donut.

props.name: data
props.description: Slices to render. A flat array of `{ label, value, color? }` entries.

props.name: options
props.description: Visual options override — palette, donut hole, slice gap, label rendering, hover/entrance animations.

props.name: colors
props.description: Palette fallback (defaults to theme.seriesColors).

props.name: innerRadiusRatio
props.description: 0 = pie, 0.6 = donut. Fraction of the outer radius used as an inner hole.

props.name: padAngle
props.description: Gap between slices in degrees. Default: 1.15° (≈ 0.02 rad).

props.name: cornerRadius
props.description:
Rounds each slice's corners in CSS pixels — the two where the outer rim
meets the straight edges, plus two more on the inner rim once
`innerRadiusRatio > 0` carves out a donut hole. Default: 3 (matching the
bar/candlestick families); pass 0 for sharp wedges. Thin rings and narrow
slices automatically clamp the radius down to whatever they can fit
without the corners overlapping, so a value that's too large for a given
slice degrades gracefully instead of producing a malformed shape.

props.name: label
props.description: Display the label shown in the tooltip.

props.name: sliceLabels
props.description: Per-slice label rendering on the pie itself. See PieLabelsOptions.

props.name: mode
props.description: Default: `'outside'`.

props.name: content
props.description: What to display per label. Default: `'both'` (e.g. `"BTC  42%"`).

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Font size in CSS pixels. Default: 11.

props.name: minSliceAngle
props.description:
Slices narrower than this (in degrees) get no on-pie label. Default: 2.5°
(≈ 0.7% of the pie). Raise when many tiny slices would crowd the
de-cluster pass into unreadable overlaps.

props.name: elbowLen
props.description: Leader-line radial segment length in CSS pixels. Default: 12.

props.name: legPad
props.description: Gap between leader line and text in CSS pixels. Default: 6.

props.name: distance
props.description:
Radial distance in CSS pixels from the pie's outer edge to the natural
label anchor point. The label then extends horizontally outward by
railWidth before the text starts. Clamped internally against
elbowLen. Default: 14.

props.name: railWidth
props.description:
Horizontal length of the final leader-line segment in CSS pixels — the
straight tail that runs from the radial elbow out to the text anchor.
Higher values give a longer visible "rail" before the label. Default: 16.

props.name: labelGap
props.description:
Minimum vertical gap between adjacent outside labels on the same side,
expressed as a multiplier of fontSize. Default: 1.8.

props.name: other
props.description:
Group the smallest slices into a single "Other" slice when the dataset
exceeds `maxSlices` (default: 8 rendered slices total). On by default so
dense datasets stay readable — pass `false` to always render every slice.
See PieOtherOptions.

props.name: maxSlices
props.description: Max number of rendered slices including "Other". Default: 8.

props.name: label
props.description: Label of the aggregated slice. Default: `'Other'`.

props.name: color
props.description:
Color override for the aggregated slice. Default: `theme.pie.otherColor`
(falls back to `axis.textColor` for themes without a `pie` block) — a
muted tone so the aggregate doesn't carry the same visual weight as a
real category.

props.name: animate
props.description:
When `true`, enables pie motion effects: the outside-label entrance
draw-in on mount / data swap, and the hover-explode slice offset.
Default: `false` — labels paint fully on the first frame and hovered
slices stay in place (hover feedback is left to the tooltip / legend /
cursor). Enable for presentations where the motion adds narrative
value.

props.name: entryMs
props.description:
Initial-load reveal duration in milliseconds. On the first data seed
(empty → non-empty) slices unfurl clockwise over this total duration,
then the outside labels draw in. Default: `600`.

```
// Per-series override:
<PieSeries options={{ entryMs: 900 }} data={data} />

// Chart-level default:
<ChartContainer animations={{ series: { pie: { entry: 900 } } }}>
  <PieSeries data={data} />
</ChartContainer>
```

`false` or `0` disables the intro (a chart-level
`animations.series.pie: false` also force-disables it). Bulk re-seeds
of a non-empty series never replay it. Skipped entirely under
`prefers-reduced-motion`.

props.name: gradient
props.description:
Per-slice radial *depth* gradient — a subtle lightening from the slice
center toward its edge that gives the pie a soft 3D sheen. On by default.
Set `false` for flat, solid-color slices (the material / infographic
look). Orthogonal to innerShadow: an explicit `innerShadow` still
paints its dark rim band even when the depth gradient is off.

props.name: shadow
props.type: boolean | { color?: string; blur?: number; offsetX?: number; offsetY?: number; }
props.description:
Ambient *outer* drop-shadow behind each slice. Adds lift for flat
dashboards. Omit / `false` to disable (default). `true` uses soft
defaults; pass an object to tune individually.

props.name: color
props.description: Shadow color. Default: `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22)`.

props.name: blur
props.description: Blur radius in CSS pixels. Default: 24.

props.name: offsetX
props.description: Horizontal offset in CSS pixels. Default: 0.

props.name: offsetY
props.description: Vertical offset in CSS pixels. Default: 10.

props.name: innerShadow
props.description:
Inner rim darkening — a dark band near each slice's outer edge that
gives the pie an "inset" / pressed look. Implemented by extending the
per-slice radial gradient with a dark edge stop, so it pairs naturally
with the existing depth gradient. Omit / `false` to disable (default).

props.name: color
props.description:
Rim color. Default: `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)` (blended over the slice
color). Accepts any CSS color.

props.name: depth
props.defaultValue: 0.3 — darkening starts at 70% of the radius
props.description:
Fraction of the slice's radial span covered by the darkened band
(0..1). Default: 0.3 — darkening starts at 70% of the radius.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable series ID — same value across remounts.

props.name: visible
props.description: Show/hide the series without unmounting it — excludes it from the Y-range fit and tooltip/legend. Default `true`. Live.

HeatmapSeries.description:
Matrix heatmap series. Cells map `(x, y)` category keys onto a sequential
color ramp derived from the theme (override via `options.colors`).

props.name: data
props.description: Cells to render. A flat array of `{ x, y, value, color? }` entries.

props.name: options
props.description: Visual options override — ramp colors, gaps, labels, animation durations.

props.name: colors
props.defaultValue:
derived from the theme — a faint wash of the accent color near
the surface up to the full accent
props.description:
Sequential ramp stops, low → high, interpolated perceptually (OKLab).
Two stops give a classic single-hue ramp; three make a diverging scale.
Default: derived from the theme — a faint wash of the accent color near
the surface up to the full accent (`theme.heatmap.colors` when present).

props.name: min
props.description: Domain minimum mapped to the first ramp stop. Default: the data minimum.

props.name: max
props.description: Domain maximum mapped to the last ramp stop. Default: the data maximum.

props.name: gap
props.description: Surface gap between adjacent cells in CSS pixels. Default: 2.

props.name: cornerRadius
props.description: Cell corner radius in CSS pixels. Default: 3.

props.name: axisLabels
props.description: Draw row labels (left) and column labels (bottom). Default: true.

props.name: cellLabels
props.description: Draw the value inside each cell (auto-skipped when it doesn't fit). Default: false.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Font size in CSS pixels. Default: 10.

props.name: format
props.defaultValue:
decimals adapt to the value domain — 2 for
unit-scale domains
props.description:
Value formatter. Default: decimals adapt to the value domain — 2 for
unit-scale domains (correlations), integers for wide ones, compact
notation (`1.2K`) past 1000.

props.name: columns
props.description: Explicit column order. Keys absent from the data render as empty columns.

props.name: rows
props.description: Explicit row order. Keys absent from the data render as empty rows.

props.name: entryMs
props.description:
Entrance duration per cell in milliseconds — the diagonal reveal wave on
first paint / grid-shape change. `0` paints instantly.
Default: chart animation config (600).

props.name: updateMs
props.description:
Value/color tween duration when a cell's value changes in place, and the
hover-lift ease. `0` snaps. Default: chart animation config (300).

props.name: id
props.description: Stable series ID — same value across remounts.

props.name: visible
props.description: Show/hide the series without unmounting it — excludes it from the Y-range fit and tooltip/legend. Default `true`. Live.

props.name: data
props.description:
Band data — one band per layer. A single band passes a flat
`{ time, low, high }[]`; several bands pass `BandPoint[][]`. To name/color
a band, pass `{ label, color?, data }` (or an array of them). Time accepts
ms or `Date`. On a numeric or category X axis (`axis.x.type`) samples
carry `x` in place of `time`: `{ x: 'EU', low, high }`.

props.name: options
props.description: Visual options override — fill, edge stroke, curve, entrance / intro / smoothing.

props.name: fill
props.defaultValue:
a gradient of the layer color from 40% opacity at the top
to 4% at the bottom
props.description:
Fill between the edges: a flat color, or a `[top, bottom]` pair painted
as a vertical gradient over each band's visible extent. Applies to every
layer. Default: a gradient of the layer color from 40% opacity at the top
to 4% at the bottom.

props.name: stroke
props.type: { visible?: boolean; width?: number; color?: string; }
props.description: Edge strokes, in the layer color at 60% opacity. Default: `{ visible: true, width: 1 }`.

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the `low` and `high` edges are stroked. Default: `true`.

props.name: width
props.description: Stroke width in CSS pixels. Default: `1`.

props.name: color
props.description: Stroke color for every layer. Default: the layer color at 60% opacity.

props.name: curve
props.description:
Edge smoothing, with the same builders as the line series. Default:
`'straight'`. `'smooth'` is monotone, so an edge never overshoots its own
samples.

props.name: entryAnimation
props.description:
Entrance style for appended points. Default: `'grow'` — the trailing
segment of both edges unfurls from the previous point.
see: entryMs — cross-linked duration for this animation.

props.name: entryMs
props.description:
Per-point entrance duration in milliseconds. Default: `250`. `false` or
`0` disables the entrance. A chart-level `animations.series.band: false`
wins over this field.

props.name: introMs
props.description:
Initial-load reveal duration in milliseconds; the full reveal lasts ~2×.
Default: `500`. `false` or `0` disables it. Bulk re-seeds of a non-empty
series never replay it. Skipped under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

props.name: introAnimation
props.description:
Initial-load reveal choreography — the line series' `LineIntroFn`
contract. The frame's `layerData` / `layerMean` / `primaryPath` describe
each band's center, and a `value` transform applies to both edges.
`heads` are ignored. Default: `unfoldIntro()` — the band opens out of its
mean.
see: introMs — cross-linked duration for this animation.

props.name: historyReveal
props.description:
History-prepend reveal for older points loaded at the front. Default:
`backfillSweepIntro()`. `'none'` makes prepended points appear at once.
see: historyRevealMs — cross-linked duration for this animation.

props.name: historyRevealMs
props.description: History-prepend reveal duration in milliseconds. Default: `400`. `false` or `0` disables it.

props.name: smoothMs
props.description:
How long both displayed edges take to catch up on every
`updateLastPoint`. Default: `250` ms. `0` or `false` snaps.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable series ID — same value across remounts.

props.name: visible
props.description: Show/hide the series without unmounting it — excludes it from the Y-range fit and tooltip/legend. Default `true`. Live.

props.name: scale
props.description: Named Y scale from the container's `scales` — autoscales on its own, sharing the time axis. Default: the default scale. Live.

DepthSeries.description:
Order book chart: cumulative bid and ask size stepping away from the
mid price. Plots on a numeric X axis — set `axis={{ x: { type: 'numeric' } }}`
on the container. A new `bids` / `asks` array morphs the book on screen.

props.name: bids
props.description: Bid levels as `[price, size]`, in any order. Cumulative depth is computed from them.

props.name: asks
props.description: Ask levels as `[price, size]`, in any order. Cumulative depth is computed from them.

props.name: options
props.description: Visual options override — `span` of the default view, side colors, stroke width, intro / update durations.

props.name: span
props.description:
Half-width of the default view as a fraction of the mid price: `0.01`
shows mid ± 1%. Without it the view reaches from mid to the nearer of
the two outermost levels on both sides, so both walls fill it.
Default: fit to the book.

props.name: bidColor
props.description: Bid wall color. Default: the theme's up color.

props.name: askColor
props.description: Ask wall color. Default: the theme's down color.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Step line width in CSS pixels. Default: `1`.

props.name: introMs
props.description:
Initial-load reveal: both walls grow outward from mid while their steps
rise from 0. The full reveal lasts ~2× `introMs`. `0` disables it.
Default: chart animation config (500).

props.name: updateMs
props.description:
Morph from the book on screen to a new snapshot or delta, the mid
marker's glide, and the hover highlight's ease. `0` snaps.
Default: chart animation config (500).

props.name: id
props.description: Stable series ID — same value across remounts.

props.name: visible
props.description: Show/hide the series without unmounting it — excludes it from the Y-range fit and tooltip/legend. Default `true`. Live.

SankeySeries.description:
Sankey diagram: flows between stages drawn as bands whose width follows
the volume. A new `nodes` / `links` pair morphs the diagram on screen.

props.name: nodes
props.description: Stages of the flow. A node no link reaches is not drawn.

props.name: links
props.description: Flows between nodes by `id`. Links must not form a cycle — the series throws on one.

props.name: options
props.description: Visual options override — node colors, node width and gap, link opacity, labels, entry / update durations.

props.name: colors
props.description: Node colors in node order, before `theme.seriesColors`. A node's own `color` wins.

props.name: nodeWidth
props.description: Node width in CSS pixels. Default: 12.

props.name: nodePadding
props.description: Vertical gap between the nodes of a column in CSS pixels. Default: 12.

props.name: linkOpacity
props.description: Opacity of the link bands, 0 to 1, over their (shaded) color. Default: 0.35.

props.name: labels
props.description: `label · value` beside each node. `false` hides them. Default: `true`.

props.name: color
props.description: Text color. Default: the theme's tooltip text color.

props.name: background
props.description: Fill of the rounded backdrop behind the text. Default: the theme background, translucent.

props.name: format
props.description: Value formatter. Default: whole numbers as they are, others compact (`1.2K`).

props.name: entryMs
props.description:
First-data cascade in milliseconds, start to end: sources grow, bands run to
their targets and fill them, labels fade in. `0` paints at once.
Default: chart animation config (1400).

props.name: updateMs
props.description:
Morph from the diagram on screen to new data, and the hover dim ease. `0` snaps.
Default: chart animation config (500).

props.name: id
props.description: Stable series ID — same value across remounts.

props.name: visible
props.description: Show/hide the series without unmounting it — excludes it from the tooltip. Default `true`. Live.

GaugeSeries.description:
Gauge: one value on an arc between `min` and `max`, with optional zones and
a center label. A new `value` glides from the one on screen.

props.name: value
props.description: The value to show. A value outside `min`…`max` clamps on the arc; the center label shows it as is.

props.name: options
props.description: Visual options override — range, angles, zones, arc or needle style, caption, value format, colors, entry / update durations.

props.name: min
props.description: Start of the range. Default: 0.

props.name: max
props.description: End of the range. Default: 100.

props.name: startAngle
props.description: Where the arc starts, in degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock. Default: -120.

props.name: endAngle
props.description: Where the arc ends, in degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock, after `startAngle` and at most 360° on. Default: 120.

props.name: zones
props.description:
Bands of the range, drawn along the arc. The value arc (or the needle) takes
the color of the zone the value ends in, and `color` past the last `to`.

props.name: zoneColor
props.description:
How the value arc (or the needle) takes its zone color. `'target'`: the color of the zone
the value ends in, so the entrance keeps one color and a glide blends into the new one.
`'morph'`: the color follows the arc as it moves and blends into the next zone near each
border. Default: `'target'`.

props.name: style
props.description: `'arc'` fills the arc from `min` to the value; `'needle'` points at it. Default: `'arc'`.

props.name: label
props.description: Caption under the value. Also the series name.

props.name: format
props.description: Text of the center value. Default: whole numbers as they are, others compact (`1.2K`).

props.name: color
props.description: Value arc / needle color where no zone applies. Default: the first theme series color.

props.name: trackColor
props.description: Color of the unfilled arc. Default: `theme.gauge.trackColor`.

props.name: rangeLabels
props.description: `min` and `max` in the arc's gap, next to its two ends; not drawn when the gap is under 60°. Default: `true`.

props.name: entryMs
props.description:
First-data sweep in milliseconds: the arc grows from `min` while the track fades in.
`0` paints at once. Default: chart animation config (900).

props.name: updateMs
props.description: Glide from the value on screen to a new one, in milliseconds. `0` snaps. Default: chart animation config (500).

props.name: id
props.description: Stable series ID — same value across remounts.

props.name: visible
props.description: Show/hide the series without unmounting it. Default `true`. Live.

RadialProgressSeries.description:
Radial progress: concentric rings, each filled to its value's share of
`max`. New values glide from the ones on screen.

props.name: data
props.description: One ring per entry, outermost first: `{ label, value, color? }`. `<PieLegend>` lists them.

props.name: options
props.description: Visual options override — the value of a full ring, ring colors, track color, entry / update durations.

props.name: max
props.description: The value of a full ring. Default: 100.

props.name: startAngle
props.description: Where each ring starts, in degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock. Default: 0.

props.name: endAngle
props.description: Where each ring ends, in degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock, after `startAngle` and at most 360° on. Default: 360.

props.name: layout
props.description: Where the rings sit and how wide they are, e.g. `heroLayout()`. Default: `ringsLayout()`.

props.name: painter
props.description: How each ring is drawn, e.g. `tickRing()`. Default: `solidRing()`.

props.name: labels
props.description:
The text of the rings: `heroCenter()` or `listCenter()` in the middle, `startLabels()`
or `headTags()` next to each ring. Default: none; use `<PieLegend>`.

props.name: colors
props.description: Ring colors in data order, before `theme.seriesColors`. An item's own `color` wins.

props.name: trackColor
props.description: Color of the ring tracks. Default: `theme.gauge.trackColor`.

props.name: entryMs
props.description:
First-data sweep in milliseconds: each ring grows from 0 while the tracks fade in.
`0` paints at once. Default: chart animation config (900).

props.name: updateMs
props.description: Glide of each ring from its value on screen to a new one, in milliseconds. `0` snaps. Default: chart animation config (500).

props.name: id
props.description: Stable series ID — same value across remounts.

props.name: visible
props.description: Show/hide the series without unmounting it — also hides it from `<PieLegend>`. Default `true`. Live.

props.name: data
props.description: Data points plotted by the sparkline. A flat `TimePointInput[]` (time may be ms or a `Date`) — the sparkline only ever shows one tiny line/bar.

props.name: flow
props.description:
Streaming-window mode: viewport is fixed at `capacity` bars wide. Pass
at least two seed points in `data` so the initial window can infer the
tick interval.

`align` controls where the seed sits at mount:
- `'right'` *(default)* — seed flush with the right edge; each tick
  shifts the viewport left by one interval and the new tick lands at
  the right edge.
- `'left'` — seed flush with the left edge; the viewport is held in
  place until empty bars on the right are consumed, then normal
  tail-scroll resumes.
- `'offscreen'` — seed starts one interval past the right edge so the
  first tick's tail-scroll animates it onto canvas (a brief "drive-in"
  effect).

props.name: theme
props.description:
Visual theme. Drives series colour, background gradient, and the change-direction colours used in the value block.
Defaults to the `ThemeProvider` theme, else the default theme of `ChartContainer`.

props.name: background
props.description: Page/container background

props.name: chartGradient
props.description: Chart area gradient [top, bottom] — subtle vignette for depth

props.name: typography
props.description: Font family and base size used across the chart's text.

props.name: fontFamily
props.description: CSS `font-family` stack applied to all text rendered by the chart.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Base body font size — titles, infobar, pie tooltip/legend default to this.

props.name: grid
props.description: Grid line appearance in the chart area.

props.name: color
props.description: Grid line stroke colour.

props.name: style
props.description: Grid line dash pattern.

props.name: candlestick

props.description:
OHLC candlestick colors. `wick` defaults to `body` in {@link createTheme }
when omitted, so most presets only need to set the body colors.

`body` shape encodes the fill: a single color renders flat; a
`[top, bottom]` tuple renders a 2-stop vertical gradient. Presets that
want the subtle lightened/darkened look pass `autoGradient(color)`.

props.name: up
props.description: Bullish candle (close ≥ open).

props.name: body
props.description: Body fill — single colour for flat, `[top, bottom]` tuple for a 2-stop vertical gradient.

props.name: wick
props.description: Wick stroke colour.

props.name: down
props.description: Bearish candle (close < open).

props.name: body
props.description: Body fill — single colour for flat, `[top, bottom]` tuple for a 2-stop vertical gradient.

props.name: wick
props.description: Wick stroke colour.

props.name: line
props.type: { color: string; width: number; areaTopColor: string; areaBottomColor: string; }
props.defaultValue: line series appearance including area gradient fill
props.description: Default line series appearance including area gradient fill.

props.name: color
props.description: Stroke colour of the line.

props.name: width
props.description: Stroke width in CSS pixels.

props.name: areaTopColor
props.description: Top stop of the area-fill vertical gradient (closest to the line).

props.name: areaBottomColor
props.description: Bottom stop of the area-fill vertical gradient (closest to the X axis).

props.name: seriesColors
props.description: Color palette for multi-series charts (stacked bars, overlays).

props.name: bar
props.type: { color: ValueColor; hoverBackground?: string; labelColor?: string; }
props.description:
Default single-layer bar color. A ValueColor: a string for a uniform
bar, or a function of the bar's value for sign / threshold coloring.
{@link createTheme } defaults it to a sign function (candlestick up / down
body), which is how bars get green-up / red-down without any option.

Optional so hand-built theme literals keep compiling — the bar renderer
falls back to {@link ChartTheme.seriesColors}`[0]`. A function value makes
the theme non-JSON-serializable; that is an accepted trade-off (the theme
editor simply omits it).

props.name: color
props.description: Default fill — a string (uniform) or a value-fn (e.g. sign-based up/down).

props.name: hoverBackground
props.description:
Backdrop behind the hovered category's bars on a category axis.
{@link createTheme } derives it from the axis text color; without it the
chart uses the same derivation.

props.name: labelColor
props.description:
Value label text (`BarSeriesOptions.valueLabels`). {@link createTheme }
derives it from the tooltip text color; without it the renderer uses
{@link ChartTheme.tooltip} `textColor`. The font is the theme font at
the axis font size.

props.name: pie
props.description:
Pie / donut specific colors. Optional so hand-built theme literals that
predate the field keep compiling — renderers fall back to
{@link ChartTheme.axis} `textColor` (the same muted tone
{@link createTheme } derives by default).

props.name: otherColor
props.description:
Fill of the synthetic "Other" slice produced by small-slice grouping.
Deliberately muted: a vivid palette color would give the aggregate the
same visual weight as a real category.

props.name: heatmap
props.description:
Heatmap sequential ramp. Optional so hand-built theme literals keep
compiling — the renderer falls back to a ramp derived from
{@link ChartTheme.line} `color` and the background at render time.

props.name: colors
props.description:
Ramp stops, low → high, interpolated perceptually. {@link createTheme }
derives a two-stop single-hue ramp: a faint accent wash near the
surface up to the full accent — which flips anchor automatically with
theme polarity (low values sink into the background in both modes).

props.name: gauge
props.description:
Gauge and radial progress colors. Optional so hand-built theme literals
keep compiling — the renderers derive the same colors at render time.

props.name: trackColor
props.description: Unfilled arc of a gauge and the ring tracks of a radial progress.

props.name: zoneColors
props.description: Default zone ramp, good → bad. A gauge's zones sample it evenly.

props.name: bands
props.description: Bollinger band / envelope fill colors.

props.name: upper
props.description: Fill for the upper band region (above the middle band).

props.name: lower
props.description: Fill for the lower band region (below the middle band).

props.name: crosshair

props.description: Crosshair line and axis label styling.

props.description: Stroke colour of the crosshair lines.

props.name: labelBackground
props.description: Background fill of the X/Y axis label pills shown at the crosshair position.

props.name: labelTextColor

Axis tick styling. `fontSize` and `textColor` are the shared defaults used

props.description: Default tick-label font size shared by both axes.

props.name: textColor
props.defaultValue: tick-label colour shared by both axes

props.description: X-axis tick-label colour. Falls back to `axis.textColor`.

props.description: Tooltip background fill.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Tooltip text colour.

props.description:
Colour of the value text. Default: each row's series colour (up / down
on candlesticks); the swatch keeps the series colour either way. Set it
when a series colour is too faint to read on the tooltip background.

props.description: Bottom stop of the miniature area-fill gradient.

props.description: Colors for candlestick-type miniature rendering.

props.type: boolean | { top?: number; overlap?: number; right?: number; left?: number }
props.description:

under a floating `<Title>` / `<InfoBar>` instead of colliding with it —
a Y-axis spring lag, a streaming spike, or a warm-up burst glides into
transparency. The mask erases canvas alpha rather than painting a cover
color, so it stays correct over a background gradient. Live.

Two directions, independently controlled:

**X (under the axis)** — panning content slides under the Y-axis column
and dissolves instead of hard-clipping at the pane edge. **On by
default** as a 60px ramp that finishes just inside the axis column,
before the label glyphs — on whichever side `axis.y.position` puts it
(a left-axis ramp ends at the pane edge instead). The axis side's key
(`{ right }` by default, `{ left }` for a left axis) overrides the total
ramp width in CSS px (`0` disables); the other key adds a plain zone at
the opposite pane edge (default off). A chart with only pie / heatmap
series has no axis column, so both keys add plain zones there.

**Top (under the header)** — opt-in. `true` enables the auto zone
(measured header + 24px run-out, half the header fold-in released so
data rides up into the zone at rest), `{ top }` sets the zone height
explicitly, and `{ overlap }` tunes how many px of the fold-in to
release (0 keeps the strict fold-in). Off unless one of those is set.

`false` — every mask off, strict edges everywhere.

**Init-only, but diffed by value, not reference.** A same-value inline
object literal is a no-op — only a genuine change to the resolved
config recreates the underlying `ChartInstance` (and its canvas), since
the animation engine doesn't support live reconfiguration yet. Still
worth a stable reference (`useMemo(() => ({...}), [deps])`) to avoid the
per-render deep-equal check, but forgetting it no longer tears the chart
down. In dev mode the container emits a console warning if it detects
>3 *genuine* recreates/s.

after an extreme leaves the window (the "sticky-Y" hold).

  up to `max` (a full-range contraction). Big outliers ease
  off slowly while small receders finish quickly, so the axis
  doesn't crawl for seconds over a few pixels. Either side
  falls back to its default when omitted.
- a scalar `AnimationTime` — **fixed**: `min === max`, every
  contraction takes the same time regardless of size (the

props.description:
Per-series-type data animations. `false` disables every per-point
animation across every series. Setting a single type to `false`
(`series: { line: false }`) disables that type only.

Per-series options (`<LineSeries options={{ entryMs, smoothMs, pulseMs }}>`)
win over chart-level numeric values. The chart-level field becomes the
default for series that don't set their own.

props.name: line
props.type: false | { entry?: AnimationTime; intro?: AnimationTime; smooth?: AnimationTime; pulse?: AnimationTime; }
props.description:
Line-series tweens. `false` disables all line animations
(entrance, live-smoothing, pulse).

props.name: entry
props.description:
Per-point entrance duration. `false` disables the entrance
(equivalent to `entryAnimation: 'none'`).

props.name: intro
props.description:
Initial-load reveal — the line draws itself left-to-right
on the first data seed, with a glowing head riding the
reveal front. The value is the per-element wave duration;
the full sweep lasts ~2×. `false` / `0` disables the intro.

props.name: smooth
props.description:
Last-value chase duration on `updateLastPoint`. `false` /
`0` snaps to the target instantly.

props.name: pulse
props.description:
Halo cycle period at the line tail. Periodic loop, not a
one-shot. `false` / `0` turns the halo off entirely (drawing
and animation loop).

props.name: candlestick
props.type: false | { entry?: AnimationTime; intro?: AnimationTime; smooth?: AnimationTime; }
props.description: Candlestick tweens. `false` disables candle entrance + OHLC chase.

props.name: entry
props.description:
Per-candle entrance duration. `false` disables the entrance
(equivalent to `entryAnimation: 'none'`).

props.name: intro
props.description:
Initial-load reveal — candles unfold in a left-to-right
wave on the first data seed. The value is the per-candle
wave duration; the full wave lasts ~2×. `false` / `0`
disables the intro.

props.name: smooth
props.description:
Live OHLC chase duration on `updateLastPoint`. `false` / `0`
snaps to the target instantly.

props.name: bar
props.type: false | { entry?: AnimationTime; intro?: AnimationTime; smooth?: AnimationTime; }
props.description: Bar-series tweens. `false` disables bar entrance + value chase.

props.name: entry
props.description:
Per-bar entrance duration. `false` disables the entrance
(equivalent to `entryAnimation: 'none'`).

props.name: intro
props.description:
Initial-load reveal — bars grow from the baseline in a
left-to-right wave on the first data seed. The value is the
per-bar wave duration; the full wave lasts ~2×. `false` /
`0` disables the intro.

props.name: smooth
props.description:
Live value chase duration on `updateLastPoint`. `false` /
`0` snaps to the target instantly.

props.name: band
props.type: false | { entry?: AnimationTime; intro?: AnimationTime; smooth?: AnimationTime; }
props.description:
Band-series tweens. `false` disables band entrance, intro and
edge chase.

props.name: entry
props.description:
Per-point entrance duration. `false` disables the entrance
(equivalent to `entryAnimation: 'none'`).

props.name: intro
props.description:
Initial-load reveal on the first data seed. The value is the
per-element wave duration; the full reveal lasts ~2×.
`false` / `0` disables the intro.

props.name: smooth
props.description:
Edge chase duration on `updateLastPoint`. `false` / `0`
snaps to the target instantly.

props.name: pie
props.description:
Pie segment entry/update tweens. `false` disables the slice
entry sweep (`update` is still parse-only; wiring lands in a
later phase).

props.name: entry
props.description:
Initial-load reveal — slices unfurl clockwise over this
total duration on the first data seed, then the outside
labels chain in. `false` / `0` disables the intro.

props.name: update
props.description: Slice resize duration when data changes.

props.name: heatmap
props.description:
Heatmap tweens. `false` disables the entrance wave, value tween,
and hover lift.

props.name: entry
props.description:
Per-cell entrance duration — the diagonal reveal wave on
first paint / grid-shape change.

props.name: update
props.description: In-place value/color tween and hover-lift ease.

props.name: depth
props.description:
Order book tweens. `false` disables the intro, the update
morph, the mid-marker glide and the hover ease.

props.name: intro
props.description:
Initial-load reveal — both walls grow outward from mid while
their steps rise from 0. The full reveal lasts ~2×.

props.name: update
props.description:
Morph from the book on screen to each snapshot or delta, the
mid-marker glide and the hover-highlight ease.

props.name: sankey
props.description:
Sankey tweens. `false` disables the reveal, the data morph and
the hover dim ease.

props.name: entry
props.description:
First-data cascade, start to end: sources grow, bands run
to their targets and fill them, labels fade in.

props.name: update
props.description:
Morph from the diagram on screen to new data, and the hover
dim ease.

props.name: gauge
props.description: Gauge tweens. `false` disables the first-data sweep and the value glide.

props.name: entry
props.description:
First-data sweep: the arc grows from `min` to the value while
the track and the end labels fade in.

props.name: update
props.description: Glide from the value on screen to a new one.

props.name: radialProgress
props.description: Radial progress tweens. `false` disables the first-data sweep and the value glide.

props.name: entry
props.description:
First-data sweep: each ring grows from 0 to its value while
the tracks fade in.

props.name: update
props.description: Glide of each ring from its value on screen to a new one.

props.name: perf
props.description:
Runtime performance instrumentation. Off by default — pass a config
factory, not a plain object (that pulls the perf module into your bundle
only when you actually use it):

- `perfHud()` — attach a {@link PerfMonitor } and render a visible HUD overlay on this chart.
- `perfHud({ windowMs, maxSamples, ... })` — same, with monitor options.
- `perfHud(existingMonitor)` — attach a visible HUD to an already-created monitor.
- a raw {@link PerfMonitor } instance — instrumentation without the HUD.

Only read at mount; changing this prop after the chart is created is ignored.

props.name: onEdgeReached
props.description:
Fired after the user releases a pan/zoom gesture that pulled the viewport
past a data edge by more than ~10% of the visible range. Hosts typically
respond by prefetching more history.

For threshold-based prefetch (load *before* the user fully overshoots),
use `<EdgeLoader>` instead — that component subscribes to `viewportChange`
and arms when the visible range nears the data edge.

Captured at mount only; changing the prop identity later is ignored.

props.name: onPointClick
props.description:
Fired on a click (or tap) on the chart canvas that isn't the tail end of
a pan drag. `info.spatialHit` resolves a pie/heatmap/custom-spatial
series directly under the pointer; for a time-series series, resolve the
point yourself from `info.time` (`chart.getDataAtTime` /
`buildHoverSnapshots`). Live — the latest callback is always used.

props.name: onPointDoubleClick
props.description:
Fired on a double-click on the chart canvas. The chart also responds by
calling `fitContent()`. Live — the latest callback is always used.

props.name: onSeriesHover
props.description:
Fired when the spatially-hovered series/index changes (pie, heatmap, or
a custom spatial kind) — `null` when the pointer leaves every hit area.
Live — the latest callback is always used.

props.name: onReady
props.description:
Fired once the underlying `ChartInstance` is constructed — on mount, and
again if the chart is ever rebuilt (a genuine `animations` value change).
Use this to reach for imperative APIs the declarative props don't cover
yet. Live — the latest callback is always used for the next rebuild.

props.name: onVisibleRangeChange
props.description:
Fired whenever the committed visible range changes — pan, zoom,
`fitContent()`, a data update that shifts the tail-scroll window, or a
`visibleRange` prop change. Live — the latest callback is always used.

props.name: onCrosshairMove
props.description:
Fired on every crosshair move, with `null` when the pointer leaves the
chart. Live — the latest callback is always used.

props.name: style
props.description:
Inline style for the chart's outer wrapper element. The wrapper fills its
parent (`height: 100%`) and keeps a 240px `minHeight` floor; pass
`minHeight: 0` for a smaller chart. Live.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class for the chart's outer wrapper element. Live.

XAxis.description: The X axis labels of any `axis.x.type` — time, numeric or category.

props.name: labelCount
props.description: Desired number of labels (≥ 2). Overrides chart-level `axis.x.labelCount`.

props.name: minLabelSpacing
props.description: Minimum pixel gap between adjacent labels (hard floor). Overrides chart-level.

props.name: format
props.description:
Custom label formatter. `x` is epoch ms on a time axis, the number on a
numeric axis, the category name on a category axis; `step` is the tick
spacing. Also formats the crosshair label and the tooltip / info-bar
headers. Default: time formatting, a locale number, or the name.

props.name: format
props.description:
Custom tick-label formatter. When supplied, overrides the built-in
range-adaptive formatter for this axis.

props.name: labelCount
props.description:
Desired number of labels (≥ 2). Overrides any chart-level `axis.y.labelCount`.
Realized count may differ ±1 after the 1-2-5 snap.

props.name: minLabelSpacing
props.description: Minimum pixel gap between adjacent labels (hard floor). Overrides chart-level.

props.name: scale
props.description:
Named Y scale (`ChartContainer` `scales`) this axis labels. Default: the
default scale. An overlay scale has no column, so only `format` and the
label density apply.

Tooltip.description:
Floating near-cursor glass tooltip that appears while hovering the chart.

Hover-only: without a crosshair position, the component renders `null`.
The companion {@link InfoBar } shows last-known values when no hover is active.

props.name: sort
props.description: Sort order for line values (default: 'none').

props.name: format
props.description:
Custom formatter for every displayed number in the default UI. Called per
row with the field hint (`'open' | 'high' | 'low' | 'close' | 'volume' | 'value'`).
Defaults: adaptive precision for ohlc/value (no decimals when a series is
all whole numbers), compact (K/M/B/T) for volume.
Ignored when children is a render-prop.

props.name: children
props.description:
Render-prop escape hatch. Receives the hover snapshots and replaces the
built-in panel contents. The floating container (positioning, blur glass,
clamping) is preserved — use
[`computeTooltipPosition`](../../core/src/tooltip-position.ts) directly if
you need your own container.

props.name: items
props.description:
Static override for auto-detected items. Renders a non-interactive legend
with just swatch + label. Ignored when children is a render-prop.

props.name: position
props.description: Layout position. Default: 'bottom'.

props.name: mode
props.description: Click behavior for the built-in UI. Default: `'toggle'`. Ignored when children is provided.

props.name: onToggle
props.description:
Fired after a click changes series visibility — via the built-in UI or a
custom children render-prop calling `item.toggle()`/`isolate()`
directly. Live — the latest callback is always used.

props.name: children
props.description:
Render-prop escape hatch. Receives the computed `items` (each carrying
its own `toggle()` / `isolate()` closures) and fully replaces the
built-in flex row / column. Callers can filter, reorder, and re-style
without reimplementing visibility wiring.

Marker.description:
A point annotation (event marker) pinned to a `time` / `value` — "anomaly
opened here", "deploy v1.2.3", "alert resolved". Renders on the chart's
overlay canvas and stays out of the series model, so it never shows up in the
tooltip, legend, or Y-range autoscale, and is clipped to the plot area.

```tsx
<Marker time={openedMs} seriesId="metric" shape="arrow-down" pulse={true} label="broke" color="#f0556a" />
```

props.name: time
props.description: X anchor — epoch ms or a `Date`.

props.name: value
props.description:
Y anchor as a data value. Omit and set {@link MarkerProps.seriesId} to snap
the marker to that series' nearest data point at `time`.

props.name: seriesId
props.description: Snap Y to this series' value at `time` when `value` is omitted. Also the default color source.

props.name: shape
props.description: Glyph at the anchor. Default: `'dot'`. Arrows point their tip at the anchor.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Reuse the line pulse halo around the anchor. Default: `false`.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional text label drawn as a callout chip whose tail points at the anchor.

props.name: color
props.description: Color override. Falls back to the series color (when `seriesId` is set), then the theme line color.

props.name: scale
props.description: Named Y scale (`ChartContainer` `scales`) the `value` maps through. Default: the `seriesId` series' scale, else the default scale.

ReferenceLine.description:
A straight reference line across the plot — a horizontal threshold / baseline
pinned to a `value`, or a vertical event boundary pinned to a `time`
(mutually exclusive). Renders on the chart's overlay layer *above* the series
and stays out of the series model, so it never affects the Y-range autoscale,
tooltip, or legend.

```tsx
<ReferenceLine value={0.5} label="alert" color="#f0556a" />
<ReferenceLine time={deployMs} label="deploy" />
```

props.name: value
props.description: Horizontal line at this Y data value. Mutually exclusive with {@link ReferenceLineProps.time}.

props.name: time
props.description: Vertical line at this `time` (epoch ms or `Date`). Mutually exclusive with {@link ReferenceLineProps.value}; wins when both are set.

props.name: color
props.description: Line and label-chip accent color. Default: the theme line color.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional text label drawn in an annotation chip at the line's near end.

props.name: style
props.description: Dash style. Default: `'dashed'`.

props.name: width
props.description: Stroke width in CSS pixels. Default: `1`.

props.name: scale
props.description: Named Y scale (`ChartContainer` `scales`) the `value` maps through. Default: the default scale.

TimeRegion.description:
A translucent vertical band shading the interval `[from, to]` — an anomaly
window, a maintenance window, a highlighted session. Renders on the chart's
main layer *behind* the series and stays out of the series model, so it never
affects the Y-range autoscale, tooltip, or legend. Omit `to` (or pass
`'now'`) for an open-ended band that extends to the right edge.

```tsx
<TimeRegion from={openedMs} to={recoveredMs ?? 'now'} fill="rgba(240, 85, 106, 0.08)" label="anomaly window" />
```

props.name: from
props.description: Left edge — epoch ms or a `Date`.

props.name: to
props.description:
Right edge — epoch ms or a `Date`. Omit (or pass `'now'`) for an open-ended
region that extends to the right edge of the plot — the "still firing" case.

props.name: fill
props.description: Band fill — any CSS color, typically translucent. Default: a faint tint of `color`.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional text label drawn in an annotation chip at the top of the band.

props.name: color
props.defaultValue: the theme's muted axis text color
props.description: Edge-line and label-chip accent. Default: the theme's muted axis text color.

Navigator.description:
Miniature navigator strip with a draggable window indicator for the main
chart's visible range. Must be rendered as a child of `<ChartContainer>`
so the chart instance is available via context.

`ChartContainer` sifts this element out of its children and places it as a
flex sibling below the canvas area — it does not render inline.

props.name: data
height
props.description: Strip height in CSS pixels. Defaults to `theme.navigator.height` (60).

props.name: style
props.description: Style override for the outer wrapper div.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the outer wrapper div.

props.name: children
props.description: Primary label (e.g. "BTC/USD").

props.name: sub
props.description:
Secondary label rendered in a muted colour next to the primary one (e.g.
"Live Candlestick", "1m", series count).

props.name: style
props.description: Extra styles merged onto the flex row.

InfoBar.description:
Compact OHLC/series info bar rendered as a flex row above the chart canvas.
Pairs with {@link Tooltip } (which then only renders its floating near-cursor part).

Pass a render-prop child for a custom layout — the built-in UI is used when
{@link children} is omitted.

props.name: sort
props.description: Sort order for line values (default: 'none').

props.name: format
props.description:
Custom formatter for every displayed number in the default UI. Called per
cell with the field hint (`'open' | 'high' | 'low' | 'close' | 'volume' | 'value'`).
Defaults: adaptive precision for ohlc/value (no decimals when a series is
all whole numbers), compact (K/M/B/T) for volume.
Ignored when children is a render-prop.

props.name: children
props.description:
Render-prop escape hatch. Receives the computed snapshots and replaces the
entire built-in layout. Filter, reorder, or re-style rows here without
re-implementing any data wiring.

props.name: seriesId
props.description:
Owning series id. **Optional** — when omitted, the first visible pie
series is picked, else the first visible radial progress series.

props.name: mode
props.description: Default: `'both'`. See PieLegendMode.

props.name: format
props.description: Custom formatter for the absolute slice value. Default: shared `formatCompact`.

props.name: position
props.description: Layout placement. Default: `'bottom'`. See PieLegendPosition.

props.name: children
props.description: Render-prop escape hatch. Receives slices + mode + format, replaces default UI.

PieTooltip.description: Tooltip for pie/donut charts. Shows hovered slice label, value, and percentage.

props.name: seriesId
props.description:
Owning series id. **Optional** — when omitted, the first visible pie
series is picked.

props.name: format
props.description: Custom formatter for the slice value. Default: shared `formatCompact`.

props.name: children
props.description: Render-prop escape hatch — receives hover info + format, replaces default UI.

HeatmapTooltip.description:
Tooltip for heatmap charts. Shows the hovered cell's row · column label,
value, and a small intensity meter locating the value on the color ramp.

props.name: seriesId
props.description:
Owning series id. **Optional** — when omitted, the first visible heatmap
series is picked.

props.name: format
props.description: Custom formatter for the cell value. Default: plain integers, compact decimals.

SankeyTooltip.description:
Tooltip for sankey charts. Shows the hovered node (`label`) or link
(`Source → Target`), its value, and its share of the outflow: of all
sources for a node, of the source node for a link.

props.name: seriesId
props.description:
Owning series id. **Optional** — when omitted, the first visible sankey
series is picked.

props.name: format
props.description: Custom formatter for the flow value. Default: plain integers, compact decimals.

props.name: children
props.description: Render-prop escape hatch — receives hover info + format, replaces default UI.

props.name: value
props.description: Numeric value to display. Each digit that changes between renders animates with a vertical spin.

props.name: format
props.defaultValue:
to `formatSignificant`: leading zeros
collapse into a count
props.description:
Value-to-string formatter. Defaults to `formatSignificant`: leading zeros
collapse into a count (`0.0₅8123`), large values take a suffix (`1.235B`).
Pass `formatCompact` / `formatPriceAdaptive` or your own function to customize.

`Intl.NumberFormatOptions` is also accepted (legacy) — it's routed
through the built-in `Intl.NumberFormat` for back-compat with callers
from before this prop was a function.

props.name: locale
props.description:
BCP 47 locale tag. Gives the decimal separator of the formatted text; a
locale other than `'en-US'` without `format` formats with
`Intl.NumberFormat`. Defaults to `'en-US'`.

props.name: spinDuration
props.description:
Per-digit spin animation duration in milliseconds. A value that arrives
sooner than this after the previous one snaps instead. Defaults to `350`.

props.name: shrinkDelay
props.description:
How long a character that left keeps its width before the number
shrinks, in milliseconds. A value that moves back and forth across
`99.99` / `100.01` then holds its width. Defaults to `0`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the root `<span>`.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style on the root `<span>`.

props.name: seriesId
props.description:
Owning series id. **Optional** — when omitted, the first visible
single-layer time series is picked, falling back to the first visible
multi-layer time series. `null` (no compatible series) renders nothing.

props.name: color
props.description: Override badge color (e.g. line color). If not set, uses up/down/neutral from theme.

props.name: format
props.description:
Custom formatter. Routed through NumberFlow as its `format` prop so the
digit-by-digit animation still plays on the output string — NumberFlow
animates whichever characters the formatter returns. Default: the
scale's `<YAxis format>`, else a range-adaptive number.

props.name: animate
props.description:
Badge motion. `true` (default) glides the badge to new values, counts the
value up during the initial reveal, and fades in with the intro. `false`
snaps with no easing. Pass an object to tune {@link YLabelAnimateOptions }.

props.name: children
props.description:
Render-prop escape hatch. Receives the resolved value, pixel position, and
direction metadata. Replaces the built-in badge + dashed line entirely.

props.name: scale
props.description:
Named Y scale (`ChartContainer` `scales`) the value maps through. Default:
the series' own scale. The badge sits on that scale's axis side — the
default axis side for an overlay scale.

EdgeLoader.description:
Subscribes to the chart's viewport and triggers a fetch when the visible
range nears the chosen data edge. Handles the boilerplate every load-on-scroll
site otherwise has to re-implement: arming after first user pan, deduping
via Promise tracking, and exposing the boundary's pixel coordinate so a
loader can be anchored to "the wall of available history".

Place as a child of `<ChartContainer>`. Time X axis only — on a numeric or
category axis it renders nothing and never triggers.

props.name: side
props.description: Which edge to watch.

props.name: threshold
props.description:
Bars from the edge that arms the trigger. Multiplied by the chart's data
interval. Default `5`.

props.name: onTrigger
props.description:
Called when the visible range moves within {@link EdgeLoaderProps.threshold}
bars of the data edge. Returning a Promise toggles `isLoading` for its
lifetime. **Resolve with `false`** to signal "no more data" — the loader
stops watching and switches the optional canvas indicator to its
`'no-data'` state. Any other resolve value (including `undefined`) means
"keep watching for the next near-edge event".

props.name: indicator
props.description:
- `'canvas'` (default): drive the chart's built-in canvas spinner via
  {@link ChartInstance.setEdgeState }. Renders inside the chart area at
  the data boundary.
- `'custom'`: skip the canvas indicator entirely. Use the render-prop
  `children` to draw your own DOM/SVG loader.
- A LoadingIndicatorFn: keep the canvas indicator, but swap its
  painter — the built-in `skeletonLoadingIndicator` (from
  `@wick-charts/core`) or a custom one, same pluggable-function
  contract either way. Drawn in a clipped stage anchored at the data
  boundary, inside the overshoot zone.

props.name: children
props.description:
Optional render-prop. Receives the live edge state — render whatever
positioned overlay you want, or return `null`.
